question: Does the fresh directed A11 reader edge write through prospectively nominated H3, a compact head set, or a distributed nine-head endpoint?

parent.licensed_fact: A11 reader loss is stable on FIT/HOLDOUT and restoring complete A11 c_proj output exactly rescues it; matched A12 control is inert.
parent.rejected_fact: The positive A11/M11 Shapley interaction sign did not transfer to joint reader removal and is not used here.

searched: all v15 head-factor and conditional head-atlas records
prior_art.closest: The old conditional P7 A11 endpoint atlas froze H3 plus nine singleton/LOO endpoints but never became eligible because complete A11 was LOO-null in a sequential clamp background. The valid v17 loss/rescue receipt supplies a different, direct module edge on unopened head outcomes.
prior_art.known_lessons: Complete-module mediation must precede head splitting. All-head output replacement must reproduce the parent A11 loss. Endpoint attribution is not Shapley. If singleton endpoints distribute, an actual cumulative combination must be executed and evaluated on held-out groups.

population.rows: All sixteen immutable v17 A2 rows; no filtering.
population.fit: group_number 0--7; used only to order heads.
population.holdout: group_number 8--15; never used to select or reorder heads.
population.positions: Every token from position 0 through each row's answer query for A11 head-output replacement.
population.source: The unchanged fixed L7H7+L9H4 donor-minus-base postcue writer intervention.

intervention.boundary: A11 c_proj argument 0, split into nine exact contiguous 128-wide head outputs.
intervention.captures: Capture source-absent and source-present A11 preprojection tensors. Every scored arm starts from the same source-present writer execution.
intervention.replacement: A removed head takes its exact source-absent slice only at registered rows/positions; all unremoved heads and all other modules remain live.
intervention.fit_order: For each head, average its FIT first-removal marginal and last-removal marginal. Sort descending by that endpoint attribution, breaking ties by lower head index.
intervention.cumulative_arms: Execute the first 1 through 8 heads in the frozen FIT order; prefix 9 is identical to all_heads_removed and is not rerun.
intervention.prospective_head: H3, fixed from earlier exact L11H3 value mediation and the common-gauge weight atlas, not from v17 head outcomes.

metrics.recovery: Signed recovery of each arm relative to the full source-present writer effect.
metrics.endpoint_attribution: 0.5 * (head_first_loss + head_last_loss); an endpoint interaction diagnostic, not an exact Shapley allocation.
metrics.cumulative_fraction: loss(prefix_k) / a11_loss, with a positive registered denominator.

predictions.pred_a_authority_source_replay_capture_h: All immutable hashes and row/source/position inventories match; no-head source-present replay is exact; every source and A11 hook fires once and cleans up; metrics are finite; the exact 31-forward price holds.
predictions.pred_b_all_nine_head_removal_reproduces_: All-head replacement reproduces captured source-absent A11 c_proj output within 1e-5 and its A11 loss agrees with the parent reader-loss value within .03 on FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_c_prospective_H3_is_a_stable_majori: H3 first and last loss are each at least .03, direction agreement is at least .875, and its endpoint attribution is at least 50% of complete A11 loss on FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_d_fit_ordered_prefix_of_at_most_thr: One common prefix length k<=3 reaches at least 80% of all-head A11 loss with direction agreement at least .875 on both FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_e_no_v17_head_outcome_was_used_to_c: The immutable population, writer, A11 boundary, all nine endpoints, H3 nomination, bars, ordering rule, and price were frozen before execution.

terminal_rules.invalid_instrument: A or B fails; no head conclusion.
terminal_rules.h3_compact_A11_endpoint: A--E pass; carry H3 into the restricted write/read tensor.
terminal_rules.compact_non_H3_A11_endpoint: A/B/D/E pass and C fails; carry the sealed FIT-ordered prefix, not H3 alone.
terminal_rules.distributed_A11_endpoint: A/B/E pass and D fails; keep complete A11 as the operational boundary and decompose its restricted weight tensor without inventing a sparse native-head circuit.

next: Use the confirmed H3, compact prefix, or complete A11 endpoint together with causal M11 to define a cross-fit shared activation basis. Then save exact U^T W_write, W_read U, and the M11 restricted bilinear tensor; decompose that weight-defined object and validate selected factors by removal/replay on a sealed population.
